Additional reviewed component details are listed below.
packages: .claude/skills/nsforge-code-generation/SKILL.md; .claude/skills/nsforge-derivation-workflow/SKILL.md; .claude/skills/nsforge-formula-management/SKILL.md; .claude/skills/nsforge-formula-search/SKILL.md; .claude/skills/nsforge-quick-calculate/SKILL.md; .claude/skills/nsforge-verification-suite/SKILL.md; scientific symbolic calculation only
capabilities: .claude/skills/nsforge-code-generation/SKILL.md: Prepare LaTeX, Markdown derivation reports and symbolic-code exports from supplied expressions.
.claude/skills/nsforge-derivation-workflow/SKILL.md: Maintain stepwise symbolic derivation records, assumptions, rollback history and external calculation handoffs.
.claude/skills/nsforge-formula-management/SKILL.md: Search and manage saved formula records with assumptions, references and verification notes.
.claude/skills/nsforge-formula-search/SKILL.md: Locate formula and physical-constant records with source identifiers and displayed expressions.
.claude/skills/nsforge-quick-calculate/SKILL.md: Guide algebraic simplification, limits, series and probability-tool calls for symbolic work.
.claude/skills/nsforge-verification-suite/SKILL.md: Request symbolic equality, derivative, integral, solution and dimension checks with displayed results.
scientific symbolic calculation only: NSForge symbolic scientific calculation interface includes distributions, probability, limits, series and algebra with recorded computational provenance.
limitation: nsforge-code-generation: Report/export guidance only; illustrative function omits R and T_ref parameters, and pharmacokinetic validity/temperature ranges are not established. nsforge-derivation-workflow: Provenance workflow only; algebraic consistency does not validate biomedical models, and example universal42C enzyme limit is not endorsed. nsforge-formula-management: Metadata management only; setting verified=true is not evidence of mathematical or empirical validation. nsforge-formula-search: Retrieval does not guarantee correctness; inconsistent example identifiers and PK model mappings are not verified, and no dosing/model validity is approved. nsforge-quick-calculate: Instruction-level algebra support only; inverse-Fourier example is inconsistent with the forward convention and is excluded. No PK interpretation or scientific model validation. nsforge-verification-suite: Conditional mathematical checks only; domains, branches and assumptions must be explicit, and dimensions do not establish empirical validity. scientific symbolic calculation only: Scientific computing enabler only. Clinical PK/PD derivation examples, individualized dosing and nsforge-usolver-collab are excluded; a separate skill review found unsupported pharmacokinetic assumptions and inconsistent dose/concentration units. Symbolic correctness does not establish clinical validity. Selected calculation registration only; local state/artifacts and profile-dependent tools apply. Other discovered, held or excluded components are outside this approval. Excluded from approval — nsforge-usolver-collab: Clinical dosing example invents age/body-fat/drug multipliers, labels a one-compartment exponential as three-compartment and reports unit-inconsistent concentration, then recommends fentanyl administration. No validated PK or dosing model.

limitation: Only these rendered retrieval outputs are approved. No longitudinal exposure series, population exposure assignment, forecast values or SIGMET output: formatter emits only forecast-array length and omits SIGMETs, coordinates, most weather fields and explicit fetched_at/observed_at fields (raw METAR retains encoded observation time). CPI is a dated current snapshot, not a historical or health-sector price index; backend year-over-year calculation, base-period selection, rounding and freshness were not independently verified, and MCP formatter drops the series/computed metadata described by the HTTP manifest. Paid upstream was not invoked; source-linked upstream repository tree returned404. Manifest v0.3 uses Vercel routes whereas actual MCP v0.4 uses Supabase for these two calls; contracts agree on output names but deployment equivalence remains untested. README has three tools versus seven current registrations. Property/demographic release claims conflict and remain unapproved; mortgage/interest rates, sanctions, property risk, crypto and session tools are excluded from this approval. No credentials, payment or tool execution.

limitation: No OCR, encrypted-PDF support, table reconstruction or verified reading order. Source iterates page objects in object order rather than traversing the document page tree; fallback combines streams as one page. Unsupported stream filters can omit content. Handler drops extractor truncated flag, so a successful HTTP response can contain incomplete text. MCP max_pages input is not honored by the handler, which uses a different pages filter. Parsing limits, font mapping, payment behavior and URL guards were not runtime-tested; document fidelity and security are not established. Other vault, meeting, payment, scraping and compression tools are outside this approval.

name: The Stall — Biomedical record retrieval
summary: Selected biomedical record retrieval components in The Stall; only the named outputs below were reviewed.
packages: capabilities/pubmed-intel.js::article PMID metadata and abstract only; capabilities/drug-intel.js; capabilities/fda-recall-watch.js
capabilities: pubmed-intel.js::article PMID metadata and abstract only: Retrieves a supplied PMID through EFetch XML and returns article metadata, abstract, author affiliations and selected MeSH terms.
drug-intel.js: Retrieves openFDA label snippets, adverse-event report counts/top reactions and limited recall records for a named drug.
fda-recall-watch.js: Searches drug, food and device enforcement records with classification/date normalization and category totals.
limitation: pubmed-intel.js::article PMID metadata and abstract only: Article mode only. XML uses regular expressions and limited entity decoding; authors/MeSH/date parsing may lose details. This is metadata/abstract retrieval, not full-text extraction or evidence grading. Search mode is separately held for JSON request parameter mismatch. drug-intel.js: One matching label only, broad-text fallback and fields truncated to300–600characters. Defaults to ibuprofen if omitted. FAERS report counts are not rates, incidence or causality; recall results capped5 without completeness guarantee. No dosing/interaction/safety decision approval; upstream errors remain component fields. fda-recall-watch.js: Limited records per category; returned descriptions/reasons/instructions are truncated. Numeric severity is a mapping of source recall classification, not independent patient-risk assessment. No exhaustive recall coverage or safety assurance. Outside approval — open-food-intel.js: extractNutrients and extractServingNutrients fall back from energy-kcal to generic energy fields and label the latter calories_kcal without conversion. Missing allergen lists also become empty and ingredients truncate600characters. Do not approve nutritional/dietary-restriction outputs. Outside approval — pubmed-intel.js::search: ESearch/ESummary transport format is not established by the code. Official reference https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/books/NBK25499/ documents retmode; no endpoint/tool execution performed. Article EFetch mode is reviewed separately.

name: The Stall — Environmental context retrieval
summary: Selected environmental context retrieval components in The Stall; only the named outputs below were reviewed.
packages: capabilities/air-quality.js; capabilities/weather-history.js; capabilities/usgs-earthquake.js; capabilities/weather.js; capabilities/weather-alerts.js
capabilities: air-quality.js: Retrieves coordinate-specific CAMS model-based AQI and pollutant concentrations through Open-Meteo.
weather-history.js: Retrieves dated daily historical weather variables and geographic metadata through Open-Meteo Archive for environmental-context analysis.
usgs-earthquake.js: Retrieves dated USGS earthquake event metadata with magnitude and optional geographic-radius filters.
weather.js: Retrieves coordinate/city weather variables and dated forecasts as environmental-context inputs.
weather-alerts.js: Retrieves active NOAA alerts with state/event filters, severity sorting and original alert metadata.
limitation: air-quality.js: CAMS modeled forecasts, not independent monitor observations; mislabeled measured_at does not establish measurement. Defaults to New York if coordinates omitted. No exposure, clinical advisory or regulatory-compliance validation. weather-history.js: Reanalysis/model data and first-result geocoding, not person-level exposure. Nulls omitted in summaries; totals of temperature or wind are not inherently meaningful. No climate attribution or causal inference. Default end yesterday may exceed source availability; selected raw daily records are the primary approved output. usgs-earthquake.js: Bounded environmental-hazard context only, not seismic risk, insurance equivalence or health impact. Max100events/30days, no pagination; tsunami field is upstream event flag, not independently verified active warning. Partial coordinate inputs silently omit geographic filter; source availability and timeout behavior not tested. weather.js: Forecast/model data, not measured personal exposure; missing precipitation becomes zero and first geocoding match may be wrong. No climate/health-risk attribution, regulatory or safety recommendation approval. weather-alerts.js: At most100alerts; total_active is pre-severity-filter count. Description and protective instruction texts truncate1000/500characters; use source alert for complete instructions. No guaranteed emergency coverage or independent safety guidance. Outside approval — earthquake-intel.js: Number(undefined) is NaN and nullish fallback does not restore default magnitude. Recent mode uses a weekly feed without applying requested days/minimum/limit; cache key omits radius and limit. Cannot approve faithful filtered hazard retrieval as implemented. Outside approval — weather-research-brief.js: Missing weather values are zero-filled in means; short-window dry-day threshold is labeled drought without climatological baseline. Synthesized findings/actions return source counts but no retrieved item URLs. Neither inference nor evidence traceability supports approving this composite; separate raw weather-history component remains bounded.

name: The Stall — Socioeconomic indicator retrieval
summary: Selected socioeconomic indicator retrieval components in The Stall; only the named outputs below were reviewed.
packages: capabilities/world-bank-data.js; capabilities/fred-query.js; capabilities/macro-indicators.js; capabilities/labor-market.js; capabilities/imf-country-outlook.js
capabilities: world-bank-data.js: Retrieves recent country-level indicator values, including population and life-expectancy codes, with source indicator names.
fred-query.js: CPI and labour/socioeconomic FRED series retrieval by identifier; dated recent numeric observations.
macro-indicators.js: Latest dated CPIAUCSL price-index and UNRATE unemployment observations.
labor-market.js: Dated US claims, payroll employment, labour participation, job-opening, unemployment and production/nonsupervisory earnings observations.
imf-country-outlook.js: Single-country IMF DataMapper CPI-inflation and unemployment year-indexed retrieval for the current year and requested horizon.
limitation: world-bank-data.js: Null years are dropped and the latest two surviving values may not be consecutive: yoy_change_pct is not approved as annual growth. Up to10most-recent values, no full pagination, hard-coded alias/unit metadata including unverified hdi code. Approve valid-code raw indicator values only, no causal/ecological-health inference. fred-query.js: Returns at most60 most-recent numeric observations; skips missing rows and does not expose original units, vintage or revision history. Frequency is inferred from date gaps and trend is a heuristic half-window comparison, not a statistical test. Approve scoped observation retrieval only, not financial-series coverage or derived-statistic validity. Static source review only; no installation, payment or tool invocation. macro-indicators.js: Approve these two raw fields only. CPI YoY fetch uses vintage_date then selects the last numeric row without verifying the matched prior-year observation; annual-change accuracy is unapproved. GDP series is nominal but output calls it real GDP; that field and interest-rate interpretation are excluded. Failed series become null, and returned dates can differ. No health-sector price-index or revision-vintage claim. Static source review only; no installation, payment or tool invocation. labor-market.js: Source labels conflict: ICSA is a count, not thousands; PAYEMS is an employment level, not net jobs added; AHETPI covers production/nonsupervisory employees, not all private employees. Do not use its mislabeled units/population. Wage YoY compares13 nonmissing observations without checking calendar alignment; openings/unemployed ratio uses possibly different dates. Derived indicators and leading-prediction claims are unapproved. Upstream availability and CSV handling untested. Static source review only; no installation, payment or tool invocation. imf-country-outlook.js: Approve these contextual indicator values only. Cache key omits horizon, so repeated requests can return a previous horizon for four hours. as_of is retrieval date, not WEO vintage; no actual-versus-projection status is retained. API errors become null arrays. Multi-country comma-path compatibility and undocumented country codes are untested; debt, fiscal and investment-risk interpretations are excluded. No health-cost inflation index or predictive validation. Static source review only; no installation, payment or tool invocation. Outside approval — policy-impact-mapper.js: Regex sector-keyword occurrence counts normalized to most-mentioned sector generate HIGH/MEDIUM/LOW impact; overall impact uses arbitrary sector/count thresholds. These are not validated policy/health impact measures. No source retrieval, and omitted input silently substitutes a Federal Reserve example; do not approve impact or compliance conclusions.

name: The Stall — Literature and reference helpers
summary: Selected literature and reference helpers components in The Stall; only the named outputs below were reviewed.
packages: capabilities/research-paper-search.js; capabilities/wikipedia-intel.js; capabilities/document-qa-prep.js; capabilities/fact-check.js
capabilities: research-paper-search.js: Queries OpenAlex works with year/open-access filters and returns DOI, authors, citation counts and decoded abstract snippets.
wikipedia-intel.js: Searches Wikipedia titles or fetches exact-title summaries, returning short extracts and page URLs for preliminary concept lookup.
document-qa-prep.js: Supplied-document text cleanup, paragraph/sentence chunk preparation and attached source metadata for evidence-retrieval inputs.
fact-check.js: Claim-assisted lookup of Wikipedia article summaries, returning source titles, URLs and short excerpts for manual reference checking.
limitation: research-paper-search.js: At most10 results and500-character abstracts, first5authors; no pagination or systematic retrieval. Citation count is not evidence quality. Current upstream authentication/API compatibility not tested. wikipedia-intel.js: Secondary reference context only, not literature evidence or medical advice. Extracts cap800characters, results8; exact-title branch uses English pageSummary regardless of requested lang. Language-specific exact lookup and completeness not approved. document-qa-prep.js: No PDF parsing, embeddings, retrieval or question answering. Four-character token estimates and language/type labels are heuristic. Oversized paragraphs/sentences can exceed target size despite comments suggesting a hard split; hash IDs are not collision-proof. An explicit zero overlap falls back to50, and empty input silently becomes a sample document. Limit500000characters; whole-document fidelity and retrieval quality untested. Static source review only; no installation, payment or tool invocation. fact-check.js: Approval is confined to retrieved reference-source excerpts, not the AI verdict, confidence or factual-verification claim. Requires server-side OpenAI calls to derive queries and synthesize; at most four unique articles, with600characters each supplied to synthesis and200characters returned. Wikipedia summaries are secondary evidence; missing evidence still goes to the model. No scholarly primary-source verification, calibrated confidence, systematic recall or clinical fact-check validity. No candidate execution. Static source review only; no installation, payment or tool invocation. Outside approval — _retired/citation-formatter.js: Current registry loader reads only top-level capability JS; this file is in _retired and not registered. Even historical implementation has BibTeX/APA/MLA only despite Chicago claim; missing author can become Author, A. No current usable formatter approval. Outside approval — research-automation-brief.js: Novel automation composite suppresses gathered source items/URLs and emits LLM findings/recommendations/freshness guidance without an output evidence trail; cron output does not actually schedule runs. Prior bounded research-synthesis approval does not establish this new no-provenance automated report contract.

Normal approximations/Hedges–Olkin SE; not noncentral publication intervals. Partial eta-squared is sample-biased; d conversion assumes two groups and is not valid as a three-cohort intervention effect. Observed power is not independent evidence that a null result is uninformative; generated significance narratives require review. Correlations are associations, not intervention effects. Pairwise missingness can change sample composition; r-squared shares do not partition overlapping explained variance.
